_comment: Router config for [YOUR_VERTICAL]. Goes at <project-dir>/instructions/router-config.json. Copy and adapt this file for each vertical. All fields are optional - any field omitted falls back to defaults in router.py.
_comment_batch_table: Columns the router expects in a batch table input. The router needs at least 2 of these to match a CSV/TSV/markdown table's header row to classify it as a batch table. The Topic and Primary Keyword pair is the canonical signal.
_comment_slug_source: Which column in the batch table to derive the slug from.
_comment_brief_markers: Strings that must be present in a markdown file for it to be classified as a brief (Stage 1 output). Router requires at least (count - 1) matches to classify as HIGH confidence brief. These markers match the brief format: # BRIEF: header + structured sections.
_comment_draft_stage_markers: Walked most-advanced first. First match wins. Stage N marker means the file has completed stage N, so entry_stage = N + 1. Stage 2 marker means the file is a Stage 2/3 draft - router cannot reliably distinguish Stage 2 output from Stage 3 output, so it enters at Stage 3.
_comment_research_markers: Strings that identify a file as a Stage 0 research bundle (supporting material, not its own job).
_comment_topic_seed: Markdown/text files shorter than this (in words) with no brief or draft markers are classified as topic seeds.
_comment_stop_words: Removed from generated slugs when more than 2 non-stop-word tokens remain.
